name: SQL Querying Fundamentals
description: Can write SQL queries using SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, and all JOIN types to extract and summarise data from relational databases for business analysis.

name: SQL Analytics & Business Queries
description: Demonstrates ability to write window functions, CTEs, and subqueries to solve real analyst problems including cohort analysis, retention, and revenue reporting.

name: FP&A Reporting Essentials
description: Can explain the FP&A planning cycle, build a driver-based rolling forecast, produce a zero-based budget, and present a management P&L with variance commentary.

name: Strategic Finance & Storytelling
description: Demonstrates ability to produce a full variance bridge, build an EBITDA walk, and present financial results to leadership with a structured narrative that drives decisions.

name: Startup Unit Economics
description: Can calculate CAC, LTV, and CAC payback period for SaaS and non-SaaS models, interpret the LTV:CAC ratio, and assess whether a business model is capital-efficient.

name: Fundraising & SaaS Metrics
description: Demonstrates the ability to calculate burn rate and runway, decode a term sheet and SAFE, build an ARR waterfall, and assemble the SaaS metrics dashboard investors expect at Series A.
